razonamiento: The architecture shows NHS Digital's secure data access environment. Internal users connect to an EC2 instance hosting Apache Guacamole acting as a public gateway on the left side of a security boundary. Authentication is verified through AWS Directory Service (AD). Inside the secure sandbox environment, Amazon EMR processes analytics jobs against data stored in Parquet format in Amazon S3, secured with AWS KMS encryption. Amazon RDS is also linked to KMS for encryption, and a secondary EC2 instance writes or reads data to/from S3.
